subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Which open fix path should own the remaining pathless `read` image media bridge for this issue?
rationale: Current main only covers already-extracted media, and the open candidates take different approaches with different security and compatibility implications.

options.title: Prefer media-store bridge
options.body: Review and narrow the approach from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 so trusted inline image bytes become `media://inbound/...` references before outbound delivery.

options.title: Prefer args-path fallback
options.body: Review the approach from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 if maintainers want to preserve the original local file path when the read result lacks `details.path`.

options.title: Pause for Feishu security cleanup
options.body: Hold the media bridge until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98250 defines the local-media fallback policy that the chosen fix must obey.

recommendation.title: Prefer media-store bridge
recommendation.body: Review and narrow the approach from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 so trusted inline image bytes become `media://inbound/...` references before outbound delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The release/current-main history is the best available maintainer-routing signal in this checkout, even though exact code ownership is ambiguous.
